role: логотип (S01, S02); task override: text-free crest, title supplied as live text; states: —; display CSS px: 300×120 / 520×208; source authoring is 2x, plan size is full-canvas 1x
prompt:
forged iron drill-bit crest with rivets and molten orange cracks, empty central nameplate for live title overlay. Transparent background. No text, letters, numerals, captions, wordmark or watermarks.

Rotating gameplay sprites use a centered overhead dome and no baked directional cast shadow (GDD exception).
